newsitem.title: FINLAND: Metsa-Serla jumps on chemicals sale.
newsitem.headline: Metsa-Serla jumps on chemicals sale.

text.p: Finnish paper and pulp company Metsa-Serla Oy rose in quiet trade on Wednesday following its announcement that it had agreed to sell its chemicals operations for 1.05 billion markka, brokers said.
At 1225/1025 GMT, Metsa-Serla's more liquid B share traded up 1.40 markka or almost five percent at 31.40. Volume was modest.
"The news was particularly good in the light that the equity to assets ratio will rise as result of this deal," one broker said.
Metsa-Serla said in a statement it had signed a letter of intent with Swedish Industri Kapital on the sale of its chemicals operations. It said in June it was considering selling the unit.
